source: Owner screenshot attached to the Codex conversation
line: GPU boot fw/smmu-hold fw=0 hfi=0/0 rst=1 at=0 f=0/40000408 irq=0/0 held=1 axi=80100000/100001/0

ddrss_gpu_axi.note: The third field is the retained default, not a readback: the SMMU clock pulse returned before its rollback loop because the SID5 route and backing are held for the boot.

smmu.cb0_fsr_decode: FORMAT=2 (AArch64 walk), PF (permission fault), SS (stream stalled)

interpretation: The DDR AXI branch enabled and the GMU firmware reached the CM3 release. FW_INIT never read 0x100: the first GMU bus access after release took a CB0 permission fault that the stalled stream waited on. The AO and CM3 fatal bits stayed clear and every configuration readback matched, so the failure is an access-permission rejection, not a register or clock refusal.
